project: Confidence-Aware Model Ensemble and LLM Reasoning for Response Clarity Classification

source_paper.title: "I Never Said That": A dataset, taxonomy and baselines on response clarity classification

taxonomy.description: The original taxonomy maps nine fine-grained evasion labels to three high-level clarity labels.
taxonomy.note: The paper uses Ambivalent Reply, while the released dataset uses Ambivalent. The dataset label is retained in this project.

label_definitions.Clear Reply: The response clearly provides the information requested by the question.
label_definitions.Ambivalent: The response is unclear or allows multiple interpretations.
label_definitions.Clear Non-Reply: The response does not provide the requested information, for example by refusing to answer, claiming ignorance, or asking for clarification.

label_definitions.Explicit: The requested information is explicitly stated in the expected form.
label_definitions.Implicit: The requested information is conveyed indirectly rather than explicitly.
label_definitions.Dodging: The response ignores the question altogether.
label_definitions.General: The response is too general and lacks the requested specificity.
label_definitions.Deflection: The response starts on topic but shifts the focus to a different point.
label_definitions.Declining to answer: The respondent directly or indirectly refuses to answer.
label_definitions.Claims ignorance: The respondent claims not to know the requested information.
label_definitions.Clarification: The respondent asks for clarification instead of providing the requested information.
label_definitions.Partial/half-answer: The response provides only a specific component of the requested information.

No_Majority.description: The three test annotators provide three different labels, so no majority label can be assigned.

Missing_Annotation.description: One or more annotator labels are missing.

majority_voting_rules.note: Majority voting is an additional project-derived reference. It is not assumed to be the official evaluation method of the original paper.

evaluation_notes: Task 1 uses the original clarity_label column.
Task 2 training uses the original evasion_label column.
Task 2 test data preserves annotator1, annotator2, and annotator3.
The nine Task 2 labels follow the original fine-grained taxonomy.
The taxonomy_hierarchy records the original mapping from the nine evasion labels to the three clarity labels.
No_Majority and Missing_Annotation are annotation-status labels, not official classification classes.
The derived majority-vote label must not silently replace the original annotator labels.
The final multi-annotator evaluation protocol must be agreed upon by the group.
